about_the_game:
STAR BATTLE – Overview & Key Features

Overview

STAR BATTLE is a high-speed, third-person shooter that drops you straight into the cockpit of the most iconic Mobile Suits in the Gundam universe. Re-imagined in super-deformed (SD) style, every unit bursts with personality while retaining the explosive firepower and melee combat the franchise is famous for. Whether you are a lone-wolf ace or a tactical squad leader, quick 4v4 to 8v8 battles keep every match intense and unpredictable.

Key Features

• Expansive Roster – Pilot over 400 Mobile Suits spanning every era, from the original units to beyond. New units arrive every month through free events or in-game crafting.

• Customization Depth – Mix and match parts, weapons, EX-skills and paint schemes to create a Suit that fits your play-style. Tune stats such as boost speed, melee damage or sniper stability for a truly personal load-out.

• Three Battle Roles – Choose General, Support or Raid type suits and master rock-paper-scissors balance. Coordinate with teammates to lock down sight-lines, push flanks or assassinate high-value targets.

• Dynamic Missions – Fight in classic deathmatch, capture the beacon, or massive 50-player PvE operations against A.I. bosses. Daily and weekly challenges guarantee fresh objectives and generous rewards.

• Competitive Ladder – Climb rank from Bronze to Newtype in seasonal leagues. Monthly tournaments feature cosmetic-only rewards, ensuring fair competition regardless of spending.

• Social Hangar – Form a Clan, share load-outs in the Design Lab, or spectate top-tier matches in the Stadium. Cross-server matchmaking keeps queues under 30 seconds worldwide.

Design

Imagine launching from a catapult in a 3-on-3 space skirmish: you boost-dodge a funnel barrage, switch to beam saber mid-air, then crash down on an enemy support suit—finishing with a dramatic cinematic cut-in. GIF loops of these moments are showcased above to illustrate the lightning-fast boost system, melee counter timing, and the satisfying “armor break” effect when a Suit’s health drops below 30 %.

Localization

All text and voice packs are fully localized into English, with subtitles for Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese available via the in-game language tab. Additional community translations can be downloaded from the Steam Workshop.

Jump in, suit up, and rewrite the battlefield in STAR BATTLE!
